sanskrit:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥ १४-२३॥
iast:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate
guṇā vartanta ityevaṃ yo’vatiṣṭhati neṅgate 14-23
translation: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the GUNAS,  who, knowing that the GUNAS operate, is self-centred and swerves not . . .
